design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Tables: hairline rules, left-aligned headers, serif font (e.g., Georgia), alternating row shading optional.
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a thick left rule in accent colour, no quotation marks.
Sidebar: box with thin border, light background tint, compact prose.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Revenue is heavily concentrated. In Fiscal 2018, key customers contributed 57% of total revenue.
pull_quotes.quote: Losing Indian Railways — its largest customer — would result in a sharp dip in revenues and adversely affect profitability.
pull_quotes.rationale: Customer concentration is the single most important risk; the company's own warning is more vivid than any paraphrase.
